title: MR. Judge: Multimodal Reasoner as a Judge
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a multimodal model designed to act as a judge for evaluating MLLM responses. While one of its evaluation criteria is 'harmfulness' (defined as avoiding malicious content or discrimination), this is treated as a standard safety constraint. The paper does not specifically evaluate, benchmark, or discuss religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or complex ethical/moral frameworks.
